iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. - **市場評價與風險**：儘管面臨監管挑戰（如 DOJ 訴訟與 EU DMA），分析師仍認為服務收入 >14% 的增長與毛利 >48% 能支撐其溢價估值，並將 Apple 列為「最佳永續持有」的標的之一。[AAPL_News_20260612_04.txt, chunk #2]
